export_method: Compiled the read-only current ClientMcpTools.java and McpToolDefinition.java with Gson into an owned ignored directory; executed actual definitions()/toJson() on the JVM. Raw export and exact command are C02 evidence; no Loader runtime tools invoked.
output_schema_note: Current McpToolDefinition.toJson emits no outputSchema. Null means absent in the source, not a synthesized compatibility promise. Responses contain text plus structuredContent.

tools.name: minecraft_observe
tools.description: Read the current client-visible player, inventory, target, screen, overlay, time, and recent chat state.
tools.completion_semantics: Read the current client-visible player, inventory, target, screen, overlay, time, and recent chat state.

tools.name: minecraft_read_item_components
tools.description: Read one actual received stack's native components on demand. Selected forbids slot; player/container require slot; container requires a visible menu.
tools.completion_semantics: Read one actual received stack's native components on demand. Selected forbids slot; player/container require slot; container requires a visible menu.

tools.completion_semantics: Read one loaded client-visible block with state, fluid, sky-light, and block-light values.
